title: Understanding Hierarchical Clustering
text: Hierarchical clustering involves grouping data points based on their similarity. In agglomerative clustering, each data point starts in its own cluster, and pairs of clusters are merged as one moves up the hierarchy.

title: What is Single Linkage?
text: Single linkage clustering, also known as the nearest neighbor technique, measures the distance between two clusters as the shortest distance between points in the two clusters.

title: Steps in Agglomerative Clustering
text: In each step of agglomerative clustering, the two clusters with the smallest distance between them are merged. This process continues until the desired number of clusters is achieved.
